interface.signature: def orderlyQueue(S: str, K: int) -> str:

preconditions.expression: isinstance(S, str) and all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in S)
preconditions.description: S is a non-empty string consisting only of lowercase English letters.
K is an integer between 1 and the length of S, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sorted(S) if K > 1 else min(S[i:] + S[:i] for i in range(len(S)))
postconditions.description: If K > 1, the result is the sorted version of S (since any permutation is reachable). If K = 1, the result is the lexicographically smallest rotation of S.

postconditions.expression: isinstance(return_value, str) and len(return_value) == len(S) and sorted(return_value) == sorted(S)
postconditions.description: The output is a string of the same length as S and contains exactly the same characters as S (a permutation).
